description: Source code for managing transactions in OvsAgent, including creation, insertion, deletion, and completion of transaction entries with hash table implementation.

classes.name: Transaction_Entry
classes.description: Represents a transaction with id, uuid, state, callback, table configuration, and status.

classes.name: Transaction_Table
classes.description: Hash table structure holding transaction entries with a fixed size.

methods.name: init_transaction_manager
methods.description: Initializes the transaction manager by creating and setting up the transaction table.

methods.name: deinit_transaction_manager
methods.description: De-initializes the transaction manager, freeing all resources.

methods.name: delete_transaction
methods.description: Deletes a transaction based on its string ID.

methods.name: insert_transaction
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new transaction into the table.

methods.name: update_transaction
methods.description: Updates the UUID of an existing transaction.

methods.name: complete_transaction
methods.description: Marks a transaction as complete, calls its callback, and removes it from the table.
